gaps: Generic KVMD clients do not provide target-bound workflow authorization.
Generic API wrappers do not expose evidence envelopes or fail-closed write gates.
patterns: KVM control is safest when plans, targets, and authorization are explicit.

novel_features.name: Structured semantic dispatch
novel_features.description: Expose named KVMD operations through stable evidence envelopes with explicit read/write policy.
novel_features.rationale: Agents need a bounded semantic surface instead of arbitrary API passthrough.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can discover safe KVM capabilities without learning endpoint details.

novel_features.name: Target-bound workflows
novel_features.description: List immutable named KVM workflows in deterministic order.
novel_features.rationale: Operators need reviewable workflow identities before authorizing execution.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Workflow plans remain inspectable and reproducible before hardware actions.
